hero.title: Hello, I am
hero.subtitle: SOFTWARE DEVELOPER
hero.paragraph: With a passion for web development, I build intuitive and scalable applications, continuously improve my skills, and enjoy working in motivated teams.

section1.subtitle: Who I Am
section1.paragraph1: I am Kenan Ćurevac, a 28-year-old engineer with a Bachelor's degree in Traffic Engineering from the University of Sarajevo, where I currently live. I have a strong affinity for mathematics and analytical thinking and participated in math competitions during my school years, which led me to programming.
section1.paragraph2: I gained two years of experience as a Software Developer, working across various aspects of frontend development. This experience strengthened my ability to structure applications and solve complex UI problems. I am fluent in English and German, having developed my German language skills from a young age through extensive exposure to German media.
section1.paragraph3: I take pride in my work and continuously expand my knowledge rather than let it stagnate. I enjoy applying what I learn in practice and have built several personal projects to further solidify and extend my skills. Feel free to take a look at them - I look forward to hearing from you!

section1.subtitle: Studies
section1.paragraph: I hold a Bachelor's degree in Traffic Engineering from the University of Sarajevo, Bosnia and Herzegovina, with a focus on road traffic.

section2.subtitle: Languages
section2.paragraph: I hold a C1 certificate in German from the Goethe-Institut. In addition, I speak fluent English at a C1 level.

section1.subtitle: Frontend Software Developer at Bloola GmbH
section1.paragraph: Worked on building and maintaining user interfaces using React, TypeScript, Redux, and Material UI. Focused on developing reusable components, managing application state, and implementing responsive and interactive UI features.

section2.subtitle: Position as a Call Agent
section2.paragraph: Worked as a Call Agent, supporting and advising German-speaking customers and handling contracts for electricity, gas, internet, and telephone services. Strengthened communication, empathy, and customer interaction skills.

section3.subtitle: Intern in the Municipality of Hadžići
section3.paragraph: Completed an internship at the Municipality of Hadžići, supporting the Department for Development and Housing-Communal Affairs. Assisted with document processing, correspondence, and administrative tasks using Microsoft Word and Excel.

section1.paragraph1: Quiz App is an interactive quiz application consisting of 10 questions with four answer options each.
section1.paragraph2: After completing the quiz, users receive an evaluation of their answers, providing immediate feedback on their performance.
section1.paragraph3: Technologies: React, TypeScript, Redux Toolkit, Material UI, The Trivia API

section2.paragraph1: Film Atlas is a film discovery platform that allows users to search for movies, TV series, and people in the film industry, with access to detailed information for each entry.
section2.paragraph2: It features current theatrical releases, popular and top-rated content, upcoming movies with trailers, and an overview of currently airing TV series.
section2.paragraph3: Technologies: React, TypeScript, SCSS, Material UI, The Movie Database API

section3.paragraph1: Pin the Place is a full-stack interactive geography quiz game where users answer ten timed questions and pinpoint locations on a world map.
section3.paragraph2: Each round is limited to 15 seconds, and players earn up to 5 points based on the accuracy of their guess. After the quiz, users receive a detailed results view with distances, points and a summary map displaying all correct answers.
section3.paragraph3: Frontend: Next.js, TypeScript, Zustand, TanStack Query, shadcn/ui, Leaflet
section3.paragraph4: Backend: Express.js, Prisma ORM, PostgreSQL, Zod
